pages.title: jet space suit
pages.text: Compared with alloy spacesuits, jet spacesuits have higher armor value, extra oxygen reserves, and - it has a jetpack that allows you to fly in the air. A jet spacesuit is expensive, but its high-speed flight capabilities will definitely make you feel it is worth the money.

Pressing different keys triggers different flight modes: press $(k:jump) to stroll in steady mode, or press $(k:jump) and $(k:sprint) simultaneously to sprint in boost mode. Steady mode will slowly lift you up from where you were, while boost mode has the effect of being propelled by a firework rocket while equipped with elytra. The jet suit requires energy to operate. Hold it and right-click on the energy station to recharge it.
